messages:
Aisha (ML Product): Quick preflight for the catalog shiproom tomorrow AM. Need final owners + blockers for three incoming open models: sable-7b, orion-3b, ember-6b. Callouts: licensing sign-off, perf profile readiness, and staging canary plan. Please drop a one-line status + ETA by EOD. cc @Lena @Tom @Priya @Diego

Lena (Curation): sable-7b: manifest + tags ✅, perf profiles looking good on bench env, docs ETA 3pm. ember-6b: metadata has tokenizer vocab mismatch (token ids differ) — need runtime/eng help to re-export. orion-3b: waiting on legal license check from @Priya.

Tom (ML Infra): Can run a scratch canary on the dedicated pool tomorrow if manifests are final by 09:00 PT. Also need quantized snapshot for ember-6b (INT8). If curation can provide the artifact and sha by 18:00 today we can include ember in the same canary.

Diego (Eng Runtime): I can build the INT8 path for ember-6b but we need an export with the kv_cache flag set. Example: `export_model --input ember-6b.pt --output ember-6b.tar --quantize int8 --kv-cache true` — otherwise runtime will mis-handle past-key-values. If someone can re-export by 18:00 I’ll start the build.

Priya (Legal): Quick note: the orion-3b license has a non-commercial clause in section 4.2. If product intends to expose this to hosted/public APIs we can’t approve as-is. Need product/pm confirm intended usage (internal-only vs public). @Aisha pls advise.

Aisha (ML Product): We need orion-3b for hosted API use (public customers) — that non-commercial restriction is a blocker. Recommendation: either get legal an exception or swap in `nova-lite` as an alternative for the initial catalog release. Ember is internal-only so legal ok for that one. @Priya is there a straightforward exception path?

Lena (Curation): Swapping to nova-lite is possible on our side, but callout: nova-lite latency and long-seq quality are slightly worse (note in risk register). Will prepare the manifest change if product approves the swap.

Diego (Eng Runtime): Also found a manifest mismatch: some manifests list `max_seq: 2048` but the model metadata expects 4096. That causes runtime truncation in staging. If curation can't patch quickly I’ll open a small CR against the manifest repo.

Tom (ML Infra): Reserving canary slot 10:30am PT tomorrow for sable + ember (if ember export completes). Canary run id: `canary-20261123-1`. Owners: update `model_manifest.yaml` with `owners:` field so infra knows who to notify on failures.

Ben (SRE): Do we need GPU quota bumped for that canary? I can add +4 GPUs for 2 hours if the canary run includes ember INT8. Someone confirm sizing.

Tom (ML Infra): Thanks Ben — I’ll estimate GPU needs after Diego’s export result and confirm by EOD.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary run `canary-20261123-1` created (queued).

Priya (Legal): I’ll try to get an exception but might take >24h. If product wants immediate ship, agree with swapping to nova-lite. Sending a quick legal note to the model provider now.

Lena (Curation): Pushed manifest patch for sable and added a TODO for max_seq mismatch — PR: `curation/manifest#872`. Ember re-export blocker: reaching out to model authors for original weights and tokenizer mapping.

Diego (Eng Runtime): Starting re-export now with kv_cache true, will post artifact sha when done. If export fails I’ll include the exact error here.

Aisha (ML Product): Plan summary: 1) Ember export by 18:00 (owner: Diego + Curation) 2) Manifest fixes by 21:00 (owner: Lena) 3) Legal confirm orion swap/exception by EOD (owner: Priya/Product) 4) Canary reserved 10:30am PT (owner: Tom/Infra) 5) Ben to confirm GPU quota if ember included. I’ll compile this into the shiproom checklist. :thumbsup:

Ben (SRE): Acknowledged — will monitor quota request and stand by.

Priya (Legal): Sent provider note — keeping you posted.

Lena (Curation): Patch merged, manifest now has correct `max_seq: 4096`.

Diego (Eng Runtime): Export complete, artifact sha: `sha256:9f3a...dead`. Uploading to s3://redwood-models/ember-6b/exports/ — kicking off INT8 build.

Aisha (ML Product): Awesome, thanks everyone. I’ll post final checklist in #product-shiproom and drop this into the meeting notes. If anything changes ping me asap.

Tom (ML Infra): Will update the canary ticket with final model shas and run id.

Aisha (ML Product): End of thread — short and actionable, perfect.
